Unfortunately, no. Return labels expire after 7 days, so a label from 9 days ago won't be valid for drop-off. Our policy doesn't say whether a new label can be issued, so I can't promise one. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to sort out, and in the meantime please hold on to the parcel.

Non-living items must be returned within 30 days of delivery, so the sooner this is sorted, the better. Live plants can't be returned for change of mind. Would you like me to escalate?
